data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month; this is an individual opt-in, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10 to 18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, remaining=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). All 18 leaves 50, then 500 or 100. This risks future income, not a guaranteed long-run gain. Intentions aren't binding; other catches require recalculation.
